versions.content: DataPtr shall either point to a linear buffer of TotalLength bytes containing the data for transmission or be a NULL_PTR. For data transmission the service TcpIp_UdpTransmit() shal l either use all data from the linear buffer if DataPtr is not a NULL_PTR , or retrieve TotalLength data bytes from the upper layer by calling Up _CopyTxData() one or multiple times in the context of this service otherwise .
